tiers.name: Language
tiers.audience: The wider group that needs the shared language and does not need a professional mark.

assessment.covers: The terms in the standard: knowledge, unit, comp, velocity, enterprise debt, the Big Pause, and a value session. There is no practical.

tiers.renewal: Three years. The holder re-reads the current text and passes the written check again. Nothing renews on its own.

tiers.name: Practitioner
tiers.audience: People who will write units and keep them accurate inside an organization.

assessment.covers: Terms, the value cycle, unit frontmatter, and the difference between the asset register and the debt register.
The candidate builds a small fictional project. Proposed: npm run validate-units checks structure in CI. An examiner grades judgment. The command does not grade judgment.

tiers.renewal: Three years. The holder submits one unit accepted under the current text. A lapsed mark stays on the public record as expired.

tiers.name: Steward
tiers.audience: The organizational steward who keeps the registers, the learner map, and the board report.

assessment.covers: An asset register, a debt register, and a learner map for a fictional project, each with an owner.
A one-page report of sessions held, both registers, readiness on five axes, certified people, and velocity. Each readiness score is explained.

tiers.renewal: Three years. The holder submits a board report signed by a sponsor in the sample or the workplace, and the Certification Board reviews it.

tiers.name: Master
tiers.audience: Practitioners whose work is judgment: what to accept, what to leave as debt, and when a unit is superseded.

assessment.covers: Accept or reject a set of proposed units on a fictional project. Say what stays on the debt register. Proposed: structure may be checked with npm run validate-units. The grade is the judgment.

tiers.renewal: Three years. The holder reviews a register they did not build and records the calls. The Certification Board samples the review.

tiers.name: Trainer
tiers.audience: Licensed trainers, including consultancies that teach a client's people and do not certify them.
prerequisites: The Master mark alone does not license training.

assessment.covers: Teach one module of Foundations from the comp. An examiner appointed by the Certification Board observes. The trainer does not choose the observer.
A written account of who examines the cohort. The examiner must not be the trainer and must not be employed by the trainer's firm for that cohort.

tiers.renewal: Two years. The license is separate from the Master mark. Renewal requires a delivery the Board observed, and a record that the trainer graded nobody from that delivery.
